briefing.ja: 文化祭の校庭で、焼きそば屋台の売上箱から釣銭袋が1つ、11時から11時30分の間に消えた。屋台のまわりにいた6人のうち1人が犯人であり、その人の証言カードには嘘が1枚だけ混ざっている。全員の証言を突き合わせて、誰の話が成り立たないかを見つける。
briefing.en: A change bag went missing from the yakisoba stall's cash box between 11:00 and 11:30 at the school festival. One of the six people around the stall took it, and one card in that person's hand is a lie.

text.2: Nobody was at the stall till from 11:12.
text.3: I remember the till was left empty from about twelve minutes past eleven.
text.4: Thinking back, there was nobody at the till from a minute or two after ten past.
text.5: My memory of the minute is shaky, but I am fairly sure nobody was standing at the till from around twelve minutes past eleven.

facts.hintJa: till = 会計台 / stall = 屋台 / empty = 誰もいない

text.2: The storeroom shutter was locked until 11:20.
text.3: The storeroom shutter stayed locked until twenty past eleven.
text.4: Anyone who went for the storeroom before twenty past would have found the shutter down.
text.5: I would not go as far as certain, but the storeroom shutter stayed locked until at least twenty minutes past eleven.

facts.hintJa: storeroom = 倉庫 / shutter = シャッター / locked = 鍵がかかっている

text.1: Broadcast desk. I saw the yard. Until 11:18.
text.2: From the broadcast desk I could see the yard until 11:18.
text.3: I sat at the broadcast desk and could see the whole yard until about eighteen past.
text.4: Very little in that yard escaped me from the desk, at least until just before twenty past.
text.5: My eyes were mostly on the script, but from the broadcast desk I could see most of the yard until about eighteen minutes past eleven.

facts.hintJa: broadcast = 放送 / desk = 机 / yard = 校庭

text.2: The walkway was roped off until 11:20.
text.3: The walkway to the gym stayed roped off until twenty past eleven.
text.4: Anyone heading for the gym before twenty past would have found the rope still across it.
text.5: The rope goes up for the stage show every year, and the walkway stayed roped off until about twenty past eleven.

facts.hintJa: walkway = 渡り廊下 / rope off = 立入禁止にする / gym = 体育館

text.1: Change bag. In the box. At 11:10.
text.2: The change bag was still in the box at 11:10.
text.3: There was no doubt about it: the change bag was in the cash box at ten past eleven.
text.4: The change bag was certainly still there when I looked into the box at ten past.
text.5: Do not hold me to the minute, but the change bag was still in the cash box at around ten past eleven.

facts.hintJa: change bag = 釣銭袋 / box = 箱 / still = まだ

text.2: The queue at the stall cleared at 11:12.
text.3: The line of customers at the stall was gone by about twelve past eleven.
text.4: The queue melted away no more than two minutes after ten past.
text.5: I would not be precise about the time, but the queue at the stall had gone by roughly twelve minutes past eleven.

facts.hintJa: queue = 行列 / clear = なくなる / line = 列

text.2: My cart blocked the yard gate from 11:13 to 11:17.
text.3: My cart stood in the yard gateway from thirteen past until seventeen past.
text.4: My cart filled that gateway from thirteen past to seventeen past, so nobody could have got out.
text.5: I had no reason to watch the clock, but my cart was standing in the yard gateway from about thirteen past until seventeen past eleven.

facts.hintJa: cart = 台車 / block = ふさぐ / gateway = 門の出入口

text.1: Banner frame. Across the gate. Until 11:25.
text.2: The banner frame stood across the gate until 11:25.
text.3: The banner frame stood across the gate until twenty-five past eleven.
text.4: Anyone leaving by the gate before twenty-five past would have had to duck under the banner frame.
text.5: I did not look at a clock, but the banner frame stood right across the gate until about twenty-five past eleven.

facts.hintJa: banner = 横断幕 / frame = 枠組み / duck under = 下をくぐる

text.1: Committee room door. I watched it. Until 11:20.
text.2: I had the committee room door in sight until 11:20.
text.3: I kept the committee room door in view until twenty past eleven.
text.4: As far as I know, I did not once look away from the committee room door before twenty past.
text.5: I was not standing guard over it, you understand, but the committee room door stayed in my view until about twenty minutes past eleven.

facts.hintJa: in sight = 見えるところに / keep = 〜し続ける / committee = 実行委員

text.2: Nothing was written on the sales sheet between 11:12 and 11:25.
text.3: Nobody wrote anything on the sales sheet between twelve past and twenty-five past.
text.4: Had any money been taken between twelve past and twenty-five past, the sheet would show a line for it.
text.5: I look at it once an hour at best, but the sales sheet shows no entry between twelve past and twenty-five past eleven.

facts.hintJa: sales sheet = 売上票 / write = 書く / entry = 記入

text.1: Tent back flap. Tied down. 11:10 to 11:20.
text.2: The back flap of the tent was tied down from 11:10 to 11:20.
text.3: The back flap of the cooking tent stayed tied down from ten past to twenty past.
text.4: With that flap tied down from ten past to twenty past, nobody could have slipped out behind the tent.
text.5: The wind was getting up, so the back flap of the cooking tent stayed tied down from ten past to twenty past.

facts.hintJa: flap = 出入口の垂れ幕 / tie down = 縛って下ろす / behind = 裏側

text.2: The spare hairnets were still sealed in their packet at 11:20.
text.3: Nobody goes into the food tent without a hairnet, and the packet was still sealed at twenty past.
text.4: Had anyone come into the tent to help before twenty past, that packet would have been opened.
text.5: I know it sounds fussy, but the spare hairnets were still sealed in their packet when I looked at twenty past eleven.

facts.hintJa: hairnet = 髪をおさえる網 / seal = 封をする / packet = 袋

text.1: Me. In the cooking tent. At 11:15.
text.2: I was in the cooking tent at 11:15.
text.3: I went into the cooking tent at about a quarter past eleven.
text.4: I was already inside the tent by then, so I had my back to the stall.
text.5: The minute is beyond me now, but I had gone through into the cooking tent by about a quarter past eleven.

lie.hintJa: cooking tent = 調理テント / go through = 通って入る / have one's back to = 背を向けている

contradictions.meaningJa: Hinaは11:15に調理テントにいたと言うが、予備の三角巾は11:20の時点でまだ未開封だったという証言がある。三角巾なしで食品のテントへ入る者はいないため、この2つは同時に成り立たない。Kaitoの11:10の証言で釣銭袋が消えた時間帯が絞られ、Rinの視界とNaoの台車とMr. Itoの視線で、その間に校庭を離れられた者がいないことが分かる。

text.2: I went out through the yard gate at 11:13.
text.3: I stepped out through the yard gate at about thirteen past and stayed outside.
text.4: I was out on the street by then, and the stall was behind the wall.
text.5: I could not put a minute on it, but I had already gone out through the yard gate by about thirteen minutes past eleven.

lie.hintJa: go out = 外へ出る / gate = 門 / street = 通り

contradictions.meaningJa: Rinは11:13に校庭の門から外へ出たと言うが、Naoの台車が11:13から11:17まで門の出入口を塞いでいた。HinaとKaitoとMr. Itoの証言と、テントの裏の垂れ幕で、その時間帯に他の経路も使えなかったことが分かる。

text.2: I was on the walkway at 11:15.
text.3: I crossed to the gym along the walkway at about a quarter past eleven.
text.4: I had walked over to the gym by then, so I was not at the stall.
text.5: It could have been a little earlier, but I had crossed the walkway to the gym by around a quarter past eleven.

lie.hintJa: walkway = 渡り廊下 / cross = 渡る / gym = 体育館

contradictions.meaningJa: Kaitoは11:15に渡り廊下を通って体育館へ渡ったと言うが、Rinは渡り廊下が11:20まで立入禁止のロープで塞がれていたと言っている。テントの裏の垂れ幕とNaoの台車とMr. Itoの視線とHinaの会計台の証言で、その時間帯に屋台のまわりから抜けられなかったことが分かる。

text.1: Me. In the committee room. At 11:15.
text.2: I was in the committee room at 11:15.
text.3: I was in the committee room getting the stall sheet stamped at a quarter past.
text.4: I was through in the committee room with the paperwork, so I was nowhere near the stall.
text.5: The sheet would tell you better than I can, but I believe I was in the committee room getting it stamped at around a quarter past eleven.

lie.hintJa: committee room = 実行委員本部 / stamp = 印を押す / paperwork = 書類仕事

contradictions.meaningJa: Naoは11:15に実行委員本部にいたと言うが、Mr. Itoは11:20まで本部の扉を見ており、誰も入っていない。Kaitoが11:12に行列がはけたと言い、HinaとRinの証言と、テントの裏の垂れ幕で、その直後の屋台のまわりの様子が分かる。

text.2: I went into the storeroom at 11:15.
text.3: I went to the storeroom for more sauce at about a quarter past eleven.
text.4: I had stepped into the storeroom for the sauce, so I was not in the yard at all.
text.5: I do that every year, and my recollection is that I was in the storeroom fetching sauce at around a quarter past eleven.

lie.hintJa: storeroom = 倉庫 / sauce = ソース / fetch = 取ってくる

contradictions.meaningJa: Mr. Itoは11:15に倉庫にいたと言うが、Hinaは倉庫のシャッターが11:20まで施錠されていたと言っている。Naoの横断幕の枠が門を塞いでいたこと、Rinの視界、Kaitoの11:10の証言、テントの裏の垂れ幕で、その時間帯に校庭を離れた者がいないことが分かる。

text.2: I was at the stall till at 11:15.
text.3: I was taking money at the stall till at about a quarter past eleven.
text.4: I had come out to cover the till by then, so I was not in the tent.
text.5: Serving is not really my job, but I had come out to cover the stall till at around a quarter past eleven.

lie.hintJa: till = 会計台 / take money = 会計する / cover = 代わりに担当する

contradictions.meaningJa: Sotaは11:15に屋台の会計台にいたと言うが、Hinaは11:12以降会計台に誰も立っていなかったと言っている。Mr. Itoの売上票、Kaitoの11:10の証言、Rinの視界、Naoの台車で、その時間帯に会計が行われていなかったことが分かる。

timelineEn: 11:05 The class put the cash box under the stall counter.
11:10 The change bag was still in the cash box.
11:12 The queue cleared and nobody was at the till.
11:15 The change bag was taken from the box.
11:20 The next shift opened the box and the bag was gone.

keyExpressions.ja: そのとき何をしていましたか。
確か…だったと思います。

keyExpressions.en: Are you telling me nobody saw you?
keyExpressions.ja: 誰にも見られていないということですか。
ほかに誰と一緒でしたか。
